subject: URGENT: Checkout integration broken in production
body: We're seeing 500 errors on the checkout API during our Black Friday load test. This is blocking our go-live tomorrow. Can we get on a call in the next hour? This is a top priority for us.

subject: Contract renewal blocked - need your sign-off today
body: Our legal team needs written confirmation on the data-residency questions we sent last week before they'll approve the renewal. If we don't hear back by end of day, the renewal slips to next quarter.

subject: Demo tomorrow is broken - please help
body: Our sandbox environment is throwing auth errors and we have an executive demo scheduled tomorrow morning. Please advise on a fix or workaround as soon as you can today.

subject: Sync on Q3 roadmap this week?
body: Can we grab 30 minutes this week to align on Q3 roadmap priorities? I need our input before the planning doc is due Friday. I'm free Wednesday or Thursday afternoon.

subject: 1:1 catch-up - performance review prep
body: Let's find time next week for a 1:1 to prep for the performance review cycle. Send me a couple of slots that work for you and I'll send an invite.

subject: Meeting request: API integration kickoff
body: We'd like to schedule a kickoff call to discuss integrating with your public API. Would Tuesday 2pm or Wednesday 10am work on your end? Looking forward to getting started.

subject: P1 ALERT: Production API down - 500 errors spiking
body: Automated alert: error rate on the production API gateway has spiked to 80% since 09:14 UTC. Customer-facing endpoints are affected. On-call engineer has been paged.

subject: Database failover in progress - checkout unavailable
body: Primary database failed over at 10:02. Checkout and billing endpoints are currently unavailable. Estimated revenue impact is $2,000/minute. Need engineering eyes on this immediately.

subject: Payment gateway outage impacting subscription renewals
body: Webhook delivery failures are causing failed subscription renewals for approximately 1,200 accounts. This requires engineering review to prevent further billing impact.

subject: Bug: Search returns zero results for multi-word queries
body: QA found that the search feature returns no results whenever a query has more than two words. Filed as NIMBUS-4821. Not customer-blocking yet but worth fixing before the next release.

subject: Issue: Invoice totals off by rounding error
body: The invoice page is showing totals off by $0.01 on line items that include tax. Low impact but noticeable to customers who check their math. Can you take a look this sprint?

subject: Customer-reported bug: Login button unresponsive on Safari
body: Forwarding a support ticket - a customer reports the login button doesn't respond on Safari. Current workaround is to use Chrome. Please investigate when you get a chance.
